issues.title: Ingest Phillips County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $6,550,316 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($3,204,729), Co. Road Fund ($2,101,902), Co. 911 Fund ($350,635). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
